title: Flexible schema presets and partial-replayable S3 export manifests
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Customers require different CSV/NDJSON export shapes depending on their analytics pipeline (raw tokens, aggregated metrics, anonymized view). Our current scheduled exports produce a single rigid schema and fail to support incremental replays without re-sending entire snapshots. This ticket implements: 1) a small set of named schema presets (compact, analytics, raw) selectable per export job; 2) export manifest enhancements to support partial-replay tokens so downstream consumers can resume from a failed chunk without duplicating rows; 3) S3 multipart + manifest checkpointing to allow interrupted uploads to resume and avoid GC of partial artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Admin/Console: user can select schema preset when configuring a scheduled export and see a preview mapping for first 10 columns/fields
Backend: export jobs produce three presets (compact, analytics, raw) as documented in the export spec; CSV/NDJSON formats supported
Manifest: each scheduled export manifest includes per-part checkpoint tokens (byte range + logical cursor) enabling partial replay of a specific tenant/date/chunk
S3 uploads: multipart uploads tracked in export metadata; interrupted uploads can be resumed using stored uploadId and part ETags
Replay API: a /v1/exports/{export_id}/replay endpoint accepts a list of manifest tokens and returns only the affected objects to re-send
Webhooks: webhook delivery includes a minimal manifest delta when sending retries and supports idempotency keys to avoid double-processing
Observability: dashboard tile showing percent of resumed uploads vs fresh uploads, and a Prometheus metric export_replay_success_ratio >= 0.98 in production for 7d
Docs & Migration: internal runbook and public docs updated; migration plan for existing jobs (default maps to legacy schema)
Automated tests covering manifest generation, replay flow, and S3 multipart resume under simulated network failures
